ModMetaData.name: Gather'Round! (Ritual Seat Range Fix)
ModMetaData.author: Reqo
ModMetaData.description:
Allows you to configure the max distance (in tiles) at which pawns will look for seats for Rituals !
(Default settings is 50 tiles max, this can be changed in the settings!) (This patches GatheringsUtility so it will also affect party spots and anything else that uses the (GatheringsUtility.InGatheringArea) method!)
(Making this was a complete struggle, took 3 whole days of figuring out how things work to make this, 10/10 experience will do it again!)
